name: Replacement engine — M57TU2D30 (long block or complete, low mileage)
oemNumber: VERIFY OEM # — look up via RealOEM.com using this VIN
recommendedBrand: BMW genuine / reputable low-mileage donor (import salvage)
notes: Confirm engine code suffix and injector/turbo compatibility matches VIN WBAFF01070L319611 build date before purchase. Complete engines aren't a single OEM part number — match by engine code (306D5) and build-date casting revision, not by number alone.

name: Engine gasket set (full overhaul kit)
oemNumber: VERIFY OEM # — look up via RealOEM.com using this VIN
notes: Includes head gasket, sump gasket, timing cover seals. Full overhaul kits are typically sold as aftermarket (Elring/Reinz) kits rather than one single BMW part number — confirm the kit is specifically listed for M57TU2D30, not the petrol M57/N57 variants.

name: Main bearing set (standard, size to be measured)
oemNumber: VERIFY OEM # — bearing color/size code must match measured crank journal
notes: Only required if replacement engine bottom end is being serviced/inspected. BMW bearings are sold in graded undersizes/color codes — the correct number depends on a measured crank journal, not the VIN alone.

name: Connecting rod bearing set
oemNumber: VERIFY OEM # — bearing color/size code must match measured crank journal
notes: Root-cause failure component on the old engine — inspect replacement engine bearings regardless of stated mileage. Same graded-size caveat as the main bearing set.

name: Timing chain kit (chain, guides, tensioner)
oemNumber: 11 31 8 506 869 (chain) — kits also sold as "11318506869K" upper timing chain overhaul kit
notes: Recommended preventive replacement on high-mileage donor engines. Part number is commonly cited across E90 335d / E70 X5 35d parts catalogs for the M57 upper timing chain — confirm it covers guides and tensioner or buy those separately.

name: Engine oil (low-ash diesel spec, 5W-30)
oemNumber: N/A — spec-matched fluid, not a single part number

notes: Commonly cited OEM oil filter number for E90 335d / E70 X5 xDrive35d (M57). Confirm on RealOEM against this VIN before ordering.

name: Radiator (complete pack)
notes: Diesel radiator pack differs from petrol X5 — commonly cited OEM/Nissens/Behr number covers E70 X5 35i/35d and E71 X6 35i. Confirm fitment for xDrive35d specifically.

notes: Replace all accessible hoses proactively during an engine-out job. Don't forget the specific water-pump-to-EGR-cooler and EGR-cooler-to-return-pipe hoses — both are named, separately sold parts on this platform.
